justification: Qwen2.5 72B Instruct was selected for this security audit task due to its cost-effectiveness with both input and output pricing below $1.00 per million tokens, meeting the budget requirement. The model offers a large 131,072 token context window sufficient for comprehensive security audit documentation. With 2.96B weekly tokens usage on OpenRouter, it demonstrates high reliability and availability. The model excels at structured tool-calling and step-by-step reasoning required for penetration testing workflows.
